clauses.label: sole paragraph
clauses.text:
Exrecutv'e Orber.
Dr. J. C. Monaghan, of Bayonne, New Jersey, who served as
American Consul at Mann heim, Germany, from June 17, 1885 to March
24, 1 890, and at Chemnitz, Germany, from March 5, j893 to March 31,
1900, and who was Chief of the Division of Consular Reports in the
Department of Commerce and Labor, from 1903 to 1906, may, in view
of his record for efficient service while in said positions, be appointed to
a post in the consular service, without regard to the Executive Order of
June 27, 1906.
